name: Raphael Sanzio
summary: Highly skilled DevOps Engineer with over 5 years of experience in automating deployment, monitoring, and management of applications and infrastructure. Proficient in cloud services, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices. Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

description: Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines, significantly reducing deployment times.
Managed infrastructure using Terraform, ensuring efficient resource allocation.
Collaborated with development teams to optimize application performance and reliability.
Automated monitoring and alerting systems using Prometheus and Grafana.
Developed and maintained cloud infrastructure on AWS, improving scalability.
Created Docker images and orchestrated containers with Kubernetes.
Wrote scripts for automated deployments and configuration management.
Participated in code reviews and provided mentorship to junior engineers.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Implemented a microservices architecture for an e-commerce platform.
Developed a real-time monitoring dashboard for system health metrics.
